Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
I cannot remember if this has been discussed before, but I want to know
what happens in the following situation:

In a three Methuselahs game, Methuselah (A) plays Major Boon once his
prey (B) has bled Methuselah (C). During the game, Methuselah (B) is
ousted, so there are just A and C left. Can A burn Major Boon by forcing
C to suffer a bleed performed by C?.

Thanks in advance.
Greetings,
Damnans

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
>===== Original Message From Damnans <damna...@ono.com> =====


A can burn the boon to force C to lose pool instead of A for a successful
bleed against A (by C). This is true even if B had not yet been ousted.
